deploy-bot: Deploy started: progressive rollout for inference-service v3.2.1 -> 1% traffic. Change window: 2026-03-20 18:00-19:30 UTC. rollout_id=rl-20260320-87

alex: Kicking off. @priya can you validate the preflight gauges? specifically latency p95 and error rate.

priya: Preflight OK. No config drift. Metrics at baseline: p95=120ms (+3ms), 5xx=0.13% (stable). Running smoke tests now.

morgan: Quick note: release notes updated with breaking change about tokenization behavior, added migration note.

jamie: I see a small spike in kv-cache miss rate from host pool-3, investigating. Suggest hold at 5% and observe.

deploy-bot: Rollout advanced to 5% (rl-20260320-87) — started 1765002468 -> now at 5%. Hooks: smoke-tests, latency-check.

priya: smoke tests passed. Latency stable. But synthetic QPS test shows tail latency (p99) increased to 380ms on 2 hosts.

jamie: Repro snippet from host-3 logs:
```
[2026-03-20T18:12:03Z] kv_cache: miss batch=42 len=128
[2026-03-20T18:12:03Z] aten: fallback_to_cpu kernel=softmax
```
Seems quantized kernel fallback. Escalating to runtime team.

alex: Given tail99 bump, I'm going to pause rollout. Hold now and pin traffic back to v3.2.0 for safety? @morgan thoughts?

morgan: Agree hold. We should not rollback fully yet—pin 80% to v3.2.0 and keep 20% on v3.2.1 for debugging. Also open a bug and assign to eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused (rl-20260320-87). Traffic policy updated: v3.2.0 -> 80%, v3.2.1 -> 20%. Tagging release as "hold". :pause_button: 

priya: Created incident tracker: INC-2026-1123, linked to rollout. Added logs + Grafana links: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd

jamie: Runtime team suggests reverting kernel change in quantization branch. If quick revert possible, we can resume to 50% after hotfix.

alex: OK roadmap: 1) runtime hotfix branch, 2) quick canary at 10% for 15m, 3) if green, increase. @deploy-bot schedule resume candidate?

deploy-bot: Noted. Manual resume required. Runbook steps included in incident. Use `/deploy resume rl-20260320-87 --to 10` once hotfix merged.

priya: SRE will run synthetic workload for 20m after resume. Ping me when ready.

morgan: I'll draft a short customer-facing note in case customers see degraded tail latency. Keep me cc'd.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll post a final update after runtime PR lands. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Thread closed for now. Will post automated updates on rollout status.
